title: Implement the baseline-definition and baseline-comparison-result contracts and the compare CLI verb (Phase 2b Task B vertical slice)
objective: Dragos explicitly authorized continuation of Task B implementation on 2026-08-10; this task contract is that authorization's executable form and covers ordinary implementation choices (field/class/method names, fixture names, internal helper structure) without a further human gate. Implement contracts/baseline-definition.schema.json and contracts/baseline-comparison-result.schema.json exactly matching docs/contracts/baseline-definition.md and docs/contracts/baseline-comparison-result.md, approved and independently reviewed in docs/architecture/ADR-0004-baseline-comparison-and-authored-estimate.md, which extends ADR-0003 (Task B follow-up gate satisfied) and preserves ADR-0001/ADR-0002/ADR-0003 without modifying their decision text beyond ADR-0003's already-existing single Status-linkage paragraph. Every normative rule (document structure, field types and requiredness, referential integrity and coverage, baseline-source coherence rules 1-5, the diagnostic registry PT400-PT404 and reused PT000-PT005/PT100-PT101, the two-phase validation order, the compare CLI's exact stdout/stderr shapes and 0/1/2 exit precedence, the applicability precedence algorithm, the observedEventCount=terminationRank+1 formula, the non-summation rollup rule, and the canonical property order and serialization) is fixed, word-for-word normative, in those two contract documents; Codex implements from them without inventing a code, pointer, message, field name, enum value, formula, or ordering. Do not modify contracts/trace-envelope.schema.json, docs/contracts/trace-envelope.md, contracts/obligation-ledger.schema.json, docs/contracts/obligation-ledger.md, contracts/evaluation-result.schema.json, docs/contracts/evaluation-result.md, contracts/termination-declaration.schema.json, docs/contracts/termination-declaration.md, contracts/stop-assessment-result.schema.json, docs/contracts/stop-assessment-result.md, ADR-0001, ADR-0002, ADR-0003, docs/architecture/ADR-0004-baseline-comparison-and-authored-estimate.md, docs/contracts/baseline-definition.md, docs/contracts/baseline-comparison-result.md, docs/product-brief.md, docs/security.md, AGENTS.md, tasks/phase-2a-stop-assessment.json, or this file (tasks/phase-2b-baseline-comparison.json), which is included in allowed_paths only so the combined candidate diff and the frozen-path check below can name it, never so Codex may edit it; a git diff of every one of those frozen paths against origin/main must be empty. Introduce zero new third-party package dependencies and no network, database, shell, or model behavior anywhere in product code, matching every prior phase's zero-dependency and no-hidden-state guarantees. BaselineDefinition 1.0 and BaselineComparisonResult 1.0: implement every field, type, requiredness rule, closed enum (baselineSource.producerType four-value, baselineSource.evidenceBasis five-value, applicability five-value), the eventBudget integer range 1..2147483647, the observedEventCount=terminationRank+1 formula, the applicability precedence (terminationAttested=false first, then outcome=stable-attainment, then the three-way eventBudget-vs-observedEventCount comparison), and the maxAuthoredEstimateUnusedEventBudget-is-a-maximum-never-a-sum rollup rule exactly as docs/contracts/baseline-definition.md's 'Document structure', 'Field types and requiredness', 'Baseline source and provenance', and docs/contracts/baseline-comparison-result.md's 'Document structure', 'Unit and formula', and 'Trace-level rollup' sections fix them. Implement the fresh PT400-PT404 diagnostic block by extending src/ProgressTrace.Core/Diagnostics/Diagnostic.cs's DiagnosticCodes with five new constants with zero collision against existing codes, and reuse PT000-PT005/PT100-PT101 unmodified in meaning (16 MiB TraceValidator.MaximumInputSizeBytes reuse, unknown/duplicate-property rejection including inside baselineSource and each obligationBudgets entry, malformed-JSON short-circuit, unsupported-schemaVersion, empty-string/closed-enum/out-of-range invalid-value), with every diagnostic's exact Code, Pointer target rule, and validation-order position exactly as docs/contracts/baseline-definition.md's 'Diagnostic registry' and 'Validation order' sections fix them, including PT404's single pointer target /baselineSource for every one of the five coherence rules, its evaluation only after producerType and evidenceBasis both validated as recognized enums, its one-PT404-per-violated-rule-in-ascending-rule-number behavior, and the fact that at most two of the five rules (at most one of rules 1-2, at most one of rules 3-5) can fire simultaneously for one document. Add a new src/ProgressTrace.Core/Models/BaselineDefinition.cs and src/ProgressTrace.Core/Models/BaselineComparisonResult.cs, a new BaselineDefinitionValidator (in src/ProgressTrace.Core/Validation/, sharing TraceValidator/ObligationLedgerValidator/TerminationDeclarationValidator's existing internal structural-validation helpers in JsonValidationHelpers.cs rather than duplicating them, running Phase A baseline-only structural checks then Phase B cross-document referential/coverage checks against the paired trace envelope and obligation ledger exactly per the 'Validation order' section) and its validation-result type, and a new deterministic baseline-comparison algorithm in a new ProgressTrace.Core.Comparison namespace (for example src/ProgressTrace.Core/Comparison/BaselineComparator.cs) that invokes but never reimplements the unmodified ProgressTrace.Core.Assessment stop-assessment logic and the unmodified ProgressTrace.Core.Evaluation.Evaluator, recomputing every Task A quantity internally from the validated trace, ledger, and declaration and never reading a precomputed StopAssessmentResult file, per ADR-0004's recompute-internally principle; no other namespace may reimplement canonical-rank, stable-attainment, applicability, or rollup logic. Add a new BaselineComparisonResultNormalizer (in src/ProgressTrace.Core/Normalization/, mirroring StopAssessmentResultNormalizer's structure without duplicating its code) producing the exact canonical property order and byte-idempotent serialization fixed in docs/contracts/baseline-comparison-result.md's 'Canonical property order' and 'Canonical serialization' sections (UTF-8, no BOM, no insignificant whitespace, null written as the JSON null literal never omitted, 0 written as the literal 0 token distinct from null, exactly one trailing newline byte). Add a fifth CLI verb, compare <trace-path> <ledger-path> <termination-declaration-path> <baseline-definition-path>, extending src/ProgressTrace.Cli/Program.cs's usage line to 'progresstrace <validate|normalize> <path> | progresstrace evaluate <trace-path> <ledger-path> | progresstrace assess <trace-path> <ledger-path> <termination-declaration-path> | progresstrace compare <trace-path> <ledger-path> <termination-declaration-path> <baseline-definition-path>' without altering any existing verb's behavior, argument count, or output shape, with the exact stdout/stderr shapes, document field values ('trace','ledger','declaration','baseline'), trace-then-ledger-then-declaration-then-baseline precedence (each document validating to completion with zero diagnostics before the next path is ever opened, size-checked, or read), and 0/1/2 exit-code precedence fixed word-for-word in docs/contracts/baseline-definition.md's 'CLI compare behavior' section: bad usage (an argument-count/verb combination matching none of validate/normalize (2 args), evaluate (3 args), assess (4 args), compare (5 args)) writes the exact usage-error JSON to stderr and exits 2 without opening any file; a PT005/oversized, unreadable, or PT000/malformed file at any of the four stages yields exit 2 with the correct document label, never opening a later path; any other diagnostic on any of the four documents yields exit 1; only when all four validate with zero diagnostics does compare recompute the Task A context internally and emit the canonical BaselineComparisonResult with exit 0, with no {"valid":true,...} wrapper, mirroring assess's existing precedent of writing the raw canonical artifact directly to stdout on success. Fixture families: (a) two new fixtures added to the existing fixtures/termination/** subtree (not fixtures/baseline/**, since they are an ordinary ledger and declaration, reused by multiple baseline fixtures below, and additive changes to that subtree are permitted since nothing in it is frozen): fixtures/termination/ledgers/valid/dual-unmet-ledger.json (traceId synthetic-non-contiguous, pairs with the existing fixtures/termination/traces/valid/non-contiguous-sequence-trace.json, two obligations obl-a and obl-b, each with a single non-satisfied signal, obl-a at nc-evt-0 status=open and obl-b at nc-evt-1 status=open, both therefore unmet-target-at-termination under the unmodified Phase 1/2a algorithm) and fixtures/termination/valid/dual-unmet-declaration.json (traceId synthetic-non-contiguous, terminationEventId nc-evt-3, terminationKind timeout, declarationSource {producerType harness, producerName example-harness, producerVersion '2.3.0', evidenceBasis harness-lifecycle}, observedEventCount=4 since nc-evt-3 has canonical rank 3); (b) six new BaselineDefinition valid fixtures under fixtures/baseline/definitions/valid/, one PTxxx-free file each, covering all five applicability values, both trace-level rollup booleans, all four baselineSource.producerType values, all five evidenceBasis values, and at least one null producerVersion: incomplete-observation-baseline.json (traceId synthetic-multi-event, pairs with fixtures/valid/multi-event-trace.json + fixtures/termination/ledgers/valid/mixed-rollup-ledger.json + fixtures/termination/valid/capture-truncated-declaration.json, obligationBudgets obl-a eventBudget=5 and obl-b eventBudget=5, baselineSource {producerType harness, producerName example-harness, producerVersion '2.3.0', evidenceBasis harness-policy}; proves both obligations report applicability=incomplete-observation regardless of their own outcome, since terminationAttested=false, and authoredEstimateFalseHaltPresent=false); stable-attainment-baseline.json (same trace, pairs with fixtures/termination/ledgers/valid/on-target-ledger.json + fixtures/termination/valid/on-target-declaration.json, obligationBudgets obl-a eventBudget=10, baselineSource {producerType operator, producerName release-operator-role, producerVersion null, evidenceBasis operator-estimate}; proves applicability=not-applicable-stable-attainment); unused-budget-baseline.json (same trace, pairs with mixed-rollup-ledger.json + mixed-rollup-declaration.json, observedEventCount=2, obligationBudgets obl-a eventBudget=10 and obl-b eventBudget=5, baselineSource {producerType agent, producerName example-agent, producerVersion '1.0.0', evidenceBasis agent-estimate}; proves obl-a=not-applicable-stable-attainment, obl-b applicability=unused-authored-budget with authoredEstimateUnusedEventBudget=3, trace-level authoredEstimateFalseHaltPresent=true and maxAuthoredEstimateUnusedEventBudget=3); budget-exhausted-baseline.json (same trace/ledger/declaration as unused-budget-baseline.json, obligationBudgets obl-a eventBudget=10 and obl-b eventBudget=2, baselineSource {producerType adapter, producerName example-otel-adapter, producerVersion '0.9.1', evidenceBasis adapter-inference}; proves obl-b applicability=budget-exhausted-exactly with authoredEstimateUnusedEventBudget=0, a defined non-null zero, and trace-level authoredEstimateFalseHaltPresent=false since a zero magnitude never counts as present); budget-exceeded-baseline.json (same trace/ledger/declaration, obligationBudgets obl-a eventBudget=10 and obl-b eventBudget=1, baselineSource {producerType harness, producerName example-harness, producerVersion '2.3.0', evidenceBasis historical-analysis}; proves obl-b applicability=budget-exceeded with authoredEstimateUnusedEventBudget=null); dual-unused-budget-baseline.json (traceId synthetic-non-contiguous, pairs with non-contiguous-sequence-trace.json + fixtures/termination/ledgers/valid/dual-unmet-ledger.json + fixtures/termination/valid/dual-unmet-declaration.json, observedEventCount=4, obligationBudgets obl-a eventBudget=10 (unused=6) and obl-b eventBudget=7 (unused=3), baselineSource {producerType operator, producerName release-operator-role, producerVersion null, evidenceBasis historical-analysis}; proves maxAuthoredEstimateUnusedEventBudget=6, strictly less than the naive per-obligation sum 6+3=9, an explicit non-summation conformance assertion mirroring StopAssessmentResult.traceOverhead's precedent); (c) golden BaselineComparisonResult fixtures under fixtures/baseline/golden/, one per valid definition above sharing the exact same file name, each the exact canonical byte-idempotent serialization for that definition's trace+ledger+declaration+baseline quadruple, including baselineSource copied verbatim in its fixed nested order immediately after algorithm;
